firstLines: Daniel Okafor
Columbus, OH | (614) 555-0182 | daniel.okafor@email.com | linkedin.com/in/danielokafor
SUMMARY
Mechanical engineer with six years of experience designing pumps and enclosures for industrial customers, from
first CAD model through production. Ohio Engineer Intern (EI) certificate.
EXPERIENCE
Harrowfield Pump Company Columbus, OH
Mechanical Engineer Mar 2022 – Present
• Redesigned the impeller housing on a 50 HP pump line in SolidWorks, cutting part count from 14 to 9 and unit
cost by $310
• Led root-cause analysis on seal failures at two customer sites; the fixture change I proposed ended the repeat
returns
• Wrote test procedures for flow and vibration testing that the quality team adopted for all new pump models
• Review drawings and tolerance stacks with two suppliers before each production release
Ironbriar Equipment Works Dayton, OH
Associate Engineer Jun 2020 – Feb 2022
• Designed sheet metal enclosures for control panels and released 120 drawings with GD&T to the shop floor
• Ran FEA on lifting brackets in ANSYS and reduced wall thickness by 20% while keeping a 3:1 safety factor
• Supported installation of a new press brake line and trained six operators on the setup sheets I wrote
Brassfork Tooling Dayton, OH
Engineering Co-op Jan 2019 – Aug 2019
• Designed and machined a drill fixture that cut setup time on a high-volume bracket from 25 minutes to 8
EDUCATION
Larchgrove University Columbus, OH
Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering May 2020
• Senior design: low-cost irrigation pump, first place among 22 capstone teams
SKILLS
Design: SolidWorks, AutoCAD, GD&T, tolerance analysis, design for manufacturing
Analysis: ANSYS, MATLAB, root-cause analysis, test planning
Manufacturing: Sheet metal, CNC machining, injection molding
